content: मङ्गल्य {%a.%} [मङ्गलाय हितं यत्] .²1 Auspicious, fortunate, happy, lucky, prosperous; मङ्गल्यं मङ्गलं विष्णुम् <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 24</ls>; मङ्गल्यं ब्राह्मणस्य स्यात् <ls>Ms. 2. 31</ls>. .²2 Pleasing, agreeable, beautiful. .²3 Holy, pure, pious; त्रिलोकीमङ्गल्याम् <ls>U. 4. 10</ls>. .{@-ल्यः@} .²1 The sacred fig-tree. .²2 The cocoa-nut tree. .²3 A sort of pulse. .²4 The Bilva tree. .{@-ल्या@} .²1 A species of fragrant sandal; मङ्गल्यागुरुशिशिरा गन्धाढ्या दोषवाहिका <ls>Rājanighaṇṭu.</ls> .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²3 A kind of aloe-wood. .²4 A particular perfume. .²5 A particular yellow pigment. .{@-ल्यम्@} .²1 Auspicious water for the coronation of a king (brought from various holy places). .²2 Gold. .²3 Sandal-wood. .²4 Red lead. .²5 Sour curds.
